annotation.equivalence_rationale: All three responses preserve the same decision-relevant evidence for prioritisation: they identify urgency, impact, and dependencies; weigh delivery delay against a possible safety issue using available evidence; and include reassessment as more information arrives. A and C are more detailed, but B still contains the same core prioritisation logic and operational commitments (investigate safety concern, stop/isolate if credible immediate risk, continue delivery if lower risk with review). No material contradiction or omission appears likely to change the criterion-level assessment.
